authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Researching and verifying humanoid robotics supply chains and component specs.

editorial.testing: We map supply chains based on publicly available data, SEC filings, supplier announcements, and engineering job postings.
editorial.monetization: We make money through site sponsorships and paid job postings for hardware engineering roles. We do not accept payment for inclusion in the supply-chain database.
editorial.corrections: If you represent a supplier or humanoid company and find a data error, please contact us for immediate correction.
